title: Pilot local E/I sentinel and bounded curator queue
description: Implement EXP-0002 from reopened IDEA-0013. Build a token-free deterministic sentinel that reads durable MAP signals and writes non-promoted E/I candidates to a review queue. Its status, last run, outputs, errors, and stop control must be visible in Command Center; it is not a hidden agent. Add a bounded core-agent curation command/report that runs only in an operator-visible terminal/session. Retrospectively test against recent known insights, then make the scanner runnable on a low-frequency local schedule. No automatic promotion, policy changes, raw transcript collection, continuous paid-model session, or background/headless agent.
acceptance_criteria: Sentinel reads only approved durable sources and produces candidate records with evidence links, signal type, deduplication key, and detected timestamp.
No candidate is automatically promoted into an Insight, Idea, task, decision, or policy.
Retrospective evaluation reports recall against INS-0024 through INS-0027, false positives/duplicates, runtime, and limitations.

Provides bounded curation actions for accept/merge/park/dismiss; every model-backed curator runs in a visible terminal/session, while deterministic scan status and controls are visible in Command Center.
Focused tests, emergence validation, task graph validation, and mirror validation pass; independent review is required before adoption.
